navbar.notes: navy-900 top bar, fixed 64px height, 2px brand-red bottom border, app icon + 'StockFlow' title on left, nav links on right; active link in brand-red; navbar shadow

page.notes: warm-oat (#F9F7F4) background, centered ~960px content column, page__header with page title and app icon; page__title for heading

card.notes: white surface (#FFFFFF), --shadow-sm (navy-tinted), --radius-md; stock table and detail panels live in cards; card__header, card__body optional sub-elements

button.variants: btn--primary (solid brand-red #FF3621, sharp 0px corners, hover #EB1600), btn--secondary (outlined, --radius-md), btn--ghost (text-only, no border)

form_input.notes: persistent visible label above input (never placeholder-only), --radius-sm on input, focus ring using --color-info (#0176D3), inline validation error message beside/below the field naming the field; min tap target 44x44px

stock_table.notes: cool uppercase header row; quantity cells right-aligned using --font-mono and tabular-nums font-variant; rows are scannable with generous row height; headers in navy-500 uppercase text-sm

status_badge.variants: badge--in-stock (success green), badge--low (warning amber), badge--out (error red), badge--on-order (info blue), badge--quarantined (navy-500); each a pill shape (--radius-pill); meaning carried by BOTH text label and color, never color alone; text uppercase text-xs

empty_state.notes: icon (line-style warehouse/stock icon) + teaching heading + explanatory copy + a CTA button; example: 'No stock at this location — receive an inbound shipment'; never a blank region

toast.notes: fixed top-right, z-index above page content; success toast auto-dismisses after ~3s; error toast persists until dismissed; never causes page layout shift; role=alert for screen readers

scan_zone.notes: barcode scan input area; flashes green (--color-success) on successful scan with stock row updating in place; flashes red (--color-error) on failure (unknown barcode, locked SKU) and shows a persistent error toast
